findings.summary: The complete candidate changes the dependency surface by exactly one pin, pypdf 6.15.0 to 6.16.1; no My Opportunities code, claim, branch, schema, configuration, or production surface changes. The separate claim records the owner-directed activation-PR exception required because the vulnerable target pin blocks every ordinary PR.

A fresh isolated Python 3.12 environment resolved pypdf 6.16.1, pip-audit 2.9.0 reported no known vulnerabilities for requirements.txt, and the untouched remote My Opportunities member-import candidate passed 154 tests plus 2 subtests with 2 skips against the new pin.
